name: Capture Conveyor
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Capture Conveyor turns Omarchy screenshots into a keyboard-first inbox, not a forgotten folder. The bar counts captures; open the panel for the newest 24, select with arrows, start a screenshot or OCR, copy its path, or reveal its folder. It refreshes every 20 seconds. Its bounded scanner lists top-level screenshot PNG names, paths, sizes, and times, and reads folder settings. It never reads image pixels, OCRs old files, watches the clipboard, uploads data, opens an account, or uses the network.
